entries.claim: This dependent same-recension digital comparison supplies the explicitly resolved Latin reading; it does not establish independent transmission or another printed edition.

The approved Benziger page prints Suscipe quaesumus and the abbreviated Per Dominum. The standard full conclusion and the audible Per omnia/response boundary are bound separately; they are not all printed on this proper page.

The general rule supplies the full Father-addressed conclusion and its terminal Per omnia saecula saeculorum with Amen. This is the standard continuation of the abbreviation on the Vigil proper page, not a full local-page quotation.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
